claude.finalText:
I changed nothing. None of the external APIs or SDKs this repository uses has changed in a way that affects its code.

**What the repo uses**
- **Groq chat completions.** The code calls the `openai/gpt-oss-120b` model with `reasoning_effort: 'low'`, in `server.js` and `scripts/generate-seo-content.js`.
- **OpenDota API.** It uses the `/matches`, `/heroStats` and `/heroes/{id}/matchups` endpoints.
- **Stripe.** It uses the `stripe` Node package with Checkout sessions, the billing portal and webhooks.
- **Other packages.** `@upstash/redis`, `axios`, `express`, `cors`, `dotenv`, `dotaconstants` and `marked`.

**What I checked**
I read Groq's official deprecations page. Groq has retired several models this year:
- `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` and `llama-3.1-8b-instant` (16 Aug 2026)
- `qwen/qwen3-32b` and `llama-4-scout` (17 Jul 2026)
- the Kimi K2 models, `groq/compound` and `groq/compound-mini`

The repo uses none of these. `openai/gpt-oss-120b` is not deprecated, and Groq names it as the recommended replacement for several of the retired models.

I did not search for OpenDota, Stripe or the other packages. The code only makes basic Stripe calls and basic OpenDota GETs, and I found nothing in it that would be affected. I didn't look for newer package versions either, so a `package.json` bump is still possible.

Sources:
- [Groq deprecations](https://console.groq.com/docs/deprecations.md)
